instanceGeneral.title: General
instanceGeneral.description: Configure instance-wide preferences including log display, keyboard shortcuts, backup retention, and data sharing.

deployment.heading: Deployment and auth
deployment.localTrusted: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
deployment.publicAuthenticated: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
deployment.privateAuthenticated: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.

censor.heading: Censor username in logs
censor.description: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.

shortcuts.heading: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating tasks or toggling panels. This is off by default.

backup.heading: Backup retention
backup.description: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.

feedback.heading: AI feedback sharing
feedback.description: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
feedback.promptNotice: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
feedback.dontAllowDescription: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
feedback.devNote: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the <0>feedbackDataSharingPreference</0> key from the <1>instance_settings.general</1> JSON row for this instance, or set it back to <2>"prompt"</2>. Unset and <3>"prompt"</3> both mean no default has been chosen yet.

signOut.heading: Sign out
signOut.description: Sign out of this Paperclip instance. You will be redirected to the login page.

instanceExperimental.lookbackError: Lookback hours must be a whole number from 1 to 720.
instanceExperimental.title: Experimental
instanceExperimental.description: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.

warning.title: Experimental features may break at any time.
warning.body: These features are opt-in and come with no compatibility guarantees. They may change, break, or be removed without notice. Avoid relying on them for critical or production workflows.

environments.heading: Enable Environments
environments.description: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.

fileViewer.heading: Experimental File Viewer
fileViewer.description: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.

isolatedWorkspaces.heading: Enable Isolated Workspaces
isolatedWorkspaces.description: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.

streamlinedNav.heading: Streamlined Left Navigation Bar
streamlinedNav.description: Reduces the maximum number of items in the left navigation bar — nests Projects under Work with a dedicated Projects page, and shows only active agents (max 5 recently-active) in the sidebar.
streamlinedNav.toggleAria: Toggle streamlined left navigation experimental setting

conferenceRoom.heading: Conference Room Chat
conferenceRoom.description: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
conferenceRoom.toggleAria: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting

planDecomposition.heading: Task Plan Decomposition Panel
planDecomposition.description: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
planDecomposition.toggleAria: Toggle task plan decomposition panel experimental setting

watchdogs.heading: Task Watchdogs
watchdogs.description: Show task detail controls for configuring watchdog agents that verify stopped task subtrees and restore live paths when work should continue.

cloudSync.heading: Cloud Sync
cloudSync.description: Show local Paperclip Cloud upstream connection, preview, push, retry, and activation review surfaces. Saved connections and run history are preserved when this is disabled.

autoRestart.heading: Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle
autoRestart.description: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.

autoRecovery.heading: Auto-Create Recovery Tasks
autoRecovery.description: Let the heartbeat scheduler create recovery tasks for task dependency chains found inside the configured lookback window.

help.name: Display name for this agent.
help.title: Job title shown in the org chart.
help.role: Organizational role. Determines position and capabilities.
help.reportsTo: The agent this one reports to in the org hierarchy.
help.capabilities: Describes what this agent can do. Shown in the org chart and used for task routing.
help.adapterType: How this agent runs: local CLI (Claude/Codex/OpenCode), OpenClaw Gateway, spawned process, or generic HTTP webhook.
help.cwd: Deprecated legacy working directory fallback for local adapters. Existing agents may still carry this value, but new configurations should use project workspaces instead.
help.promptTemplate: Sent on every heartbeat. Keep this small and dynamic. Use it for current-task framing, not large static instructions. Supports {{ agent.id }}, {{ agent.name }}, {{ agent.role }} and other template variables.
help.model: Override the default model used by the adapter.
help.thinkingEffort: Control model reasoning depth. Supported values vary by adapter/model.
help.chrome: Enable Claude's Chrome integration by passing --chrome.
help.dangerouslySkipPermissions: Run unattended by auto-approving adapter permission prompts when supported.
help.dangerouslyBypassSandbox: Run Codex without sandbox restrictions. Required for filesystem/network access.
help.search: Enable Codex web search capability during runs.
help.fastMode: Enable Codex Fast mode. This burns credits/tokens much faster and is supported on GPT-5.4 and manual Codex model IDs.
help.workspaceStrategy: How Paperclip should realize an execution workspace for this agent. Keep project_primary for normal cwd execution, or use git_worktree for issue-scoped isolated checkouts.
help.workspaceBaseRef: Base git ref used when creating a worktree branch. Leave blank to use the resolved workspace ref or HEAD.
help.workspaceBranchTemplate: Template for naming derived branches. Supports {{issue.identifier}}, {{issue.title}}, {{agent.name}}, {{project.id}}, {{workspace.repoRef}}, and {{slug}}.
help.worktreeParentDir: Directory where derived worktrees should be created. Absolute, ~-prefixed, and repo-relative paths are supported.
help.runtimeServicesJson: Optional workspace runtime service definitions. Use this for shared app servers, workers, or other long-lived companion processes attached to the workspace.
help.maxTurnsPerRun: Maximum number of agentic turns (tool calls) per heartbeat run.
help.command: The command to execute (e.g. node, python).
help.localCommand: Override the path to the CLI command you want the adapter to call (e.g. /usr/local/bin/claude, codex, opencode).
help.extraArgs: Extra CLI arguments for local adapters, comma-separated.
help.envVars: Environment variables injected into the adapter process. Use plain values or secret references.
help.bootstrapPrompt: Only sent when Paperclip starts a fresh session. Use this for stable setup guidance that should not be repeated on every heartbeat.
help.payloadTemplateJson: Optional JSON merged into remote adapter request payloads before Paperclip adds its standard wake and workspace fields.
help.webhookUrl: The URL that receives POST requests when the agent is invoked.
help.heartbeatInterval: Run this agent automatically on a timer. Useful for periodic tasks like checking for new work.
help.timeoutSec: Maximum seconds a run can take before being terminated. 0 means no timeout.
help.graceSec: Seconds to wait after sending interrupt before force-killing the process.
help.wakeOnDemand: Allow this agent to be woken by assignments, API calls, UI actions, or automated systems.
help.cooldownSec: Minimum seconds between consecutive heartbeat runs.
help.maxConcurrentRuns: Maximum number of heartbeat runs that can execute simultaneously for this agent.
help.maxTurnContinuationEnabled: Automatically queue bounded continuation runs when an adapter stops because its per-run turn cap was exhausted.
help.maxTurnContinuationMaxAttempts: Maximum automatic continuations after one max-turn stop. This is separate from max turns per run.
help.maxTurnContinuationDelaySec: Seconds to wait before starting each max-turn continuation.
help.budgetMonthlyCents: Monthly spending limit in cents. 0 means no limit.

pathInstructions.title: How to get a full path
pathInstructions.description: Paste the absolute path (e.g. <0>/Users/you/project</0>) into the input field.
pathInstructions.macStep1: Open Finder and navigate to the folder.
pathInstructions.macStep3: Hold the Option (⌥) key — "Copy" changes to "Copy as Pathname".
pathInstructions.macStep4: Click "Copy as Pathname", then paste here.
pathInstructions.macTip: You can also open Terminal, type cd, drag the folder into the terminal window, and press Enter. Then type pwd to see the full path.
pathInstructions.windowsStep1: Open File Explorer and navigate to the folder.
pathInstructions.windowsStep2: Click in the address bar at the top — the full path will appear.
pathInstructions.windowsStep3: Copy the path, then paste here.
pathInstructions.windowsTip: Alternatively, hold Shift and right-click the folder, then select "Copy as path".
pathInstructions.linuxStep1: Open a terminal and navigate to the directory with cd.
pathInstructions.linuxStep2: Run pwd to print the full path.
pathInstructions.linuxStep3: Copy the output and paste here.
pathInstructions.linuxTip: In most file managers, Ctrl+L reveals the full path in the address bar.
